prompts.question: Has this web design company won any Web Award Korea (i-AWARD) prizes for client websites or mobile services it built?
prompts.why_it_matters: Web Award Korea is South Korea's largest annual internet award; winning agencies often neglect to showcase past trophies, or conversely claim accolades that do not match official winner records.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the business name with site:www.i-award.or.kr on Google; examine the returned project evaluation pages and agency winner records to see if the agency is named as the constructing agency (에이전시/제작사).
prompts.found_when: One or more project winner pages name the company as the producing digital agency (제작사), indicating official award category, project title, and award year.
prompts.not_found_when: No pages on www.i-award.or.kr mention the company name among award recipients or agency showcases.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Search engine returns no indexed results due to network disruption or the agency operates under a completely different legal entity name than its trade brand.

prompts.question: Has this agency been awarded a Grand Prix or Winner prize at &Award (&어워드)?
prompts.why_it_matters: &Award is South Korea's top digital media and web design award sponsored by the Ministry of Science and ICT, proving high-level agency design capabilities.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the business name with site:naward.or.kr on Google; check the top archive search results for project winner cards where the agency is listed under 제작사 (production agency).
prompts.found_when: Results show project pages identifying the business as the production agency (제작사) alongside winning honours such as Grand Prix, Winner, or Minister Award.
prompts.not_found_when: No pages on naward.or.kr match the business name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site query fails to return results or the agency name matches an unrelated common generic Korean phrase.

prompts.question: Is the web design agency featured in GDWEB Design Awards rankings or portfolio showcases?
prompts.why_it_matters: GDWEB is the leading daily web design showcase and agency ranking directory in Korea, carrying peer recognition and client review visibility.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the business name with site:www.gdweb.co.kr on Google; check agency profile pages and project showcase listings where the agency is credited.
prompts.found_when: The agency appears with a designated agency profile, ranking position, or project entries awarded Winner Prize, Monthly Winner, or Grand Prize.
prompts.not_found_when: No matching agency profile or portfolio entries appear on www.gdweb.co.kr.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Search engine returns no results or fails to distinguish between the agency and the client brand name.

prompts.question: Is this company an accredited corporate member of the Korea Digital Enterprise Association (DEA)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Active membership in the Korea Digital Enterprise Association demonstrates industry accreditation and discloses verified representative names and office addresses that may contradict what the business currently displays.
prompts.how_to_query: Fetch the official member directory page at https://www.dea.or.kr/dea/intro/digi_comm.do and inspect the company cards for the company name, CEO name, and registered address.
prompts.found_when: The company is listed as an active member company (협회사), displaying its legal corporate name, representative name, and registered office address.
prompts.not_found_when: The company name is not present in the HTML list of member enterprises on this page.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The DEA member page fails to load or returns HTTP errors.

prompts.question: Is this web agency listed as a regular member of the Korea Digital Agency Association (KDAA), and do its published contact phone and CEO match current company records?
prompts.why_it_matters: KDAA (formerly Korea Web Agency Association) lists certified web development agencies; directory listings often retain abandoned phone numbers, old office locations, or former executives.
prompts.how_to_query: Reads the regular member list at http://www.kwaa.or.kr/member/member_sub02.html and searches for the company name, verifying the listed CEO, website URL, and office phone number.
prompts.found_when: The company name is found in the member directory card, displaying the representative name, website link, email, and contact phone number.
prompts.not_found_when: The company name does not appear on the regular member directory page.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The page cannot be loaded or the business is enrolled under an alternate division trade name.

prompts.question: Does this web design company hold an active, valid Web Accessibility (WA) quality mark certification for its website or its primary public client portals?
prompts.why_it_matters: Korean web agencies routinely market Web Accessibility compliance to public and corporate clients; this checks whether their certified status is currently valid or expired in the government-accredited register.
prompts.how_to_query: Queries the government-accredited certification registry at http://www.kwacc.or.kr/CertificationSite/WA/List?SearchSiteName={company} and inspects the result cards for institution name, certification dates, and status (유효 vs 만료).
prompts.found_when: The page displays one or more certification entries listing the site name, institution name (기관명), certificate period (인증기간), and current status (유효 or 만료).
prompts.not_found_when: The page returns the empty result message '검색된 데이터가 없습니다.' indicating no Web Accessibility certification exists under that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search endpoint returns an internal server error or the agency registered the certification under an unlinked client brand name.

prompts.question: Is the agency listed as an award-winning production company (제작사) in the ICT Award Korea annual winners registry?
prompts.why_it_matters: Sponsored by the Ministry of Science and ICT, ICT Award Korea honors top UI/UX and web development agencies, giving third-party validation that the business may not be leveraging.

source.name: ICT Award Korea Annual Winners (ICT 어워드 코리아 - 한국정보과학진흥협회 / 디지털인사이트)

prompts.how_to_query: Fetch the annual winners list page at https://ditoday.com/ict-award/2026-winning-entries/ and search within the HTML tables specifically under the 제작사 (Production Agency) column for the business name.
prompts.found_when: The company name appears in the table under the 제작사 column, confirming the awarded project, category, and prize level.
prompts.not_found_when: The company name does not appear in any table under the 제작사 column on this page.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The page is unreachable or updated to another year without redirecting.

prompts.question: Has this web design agency or its leadership been featured in Digital Insight (DI Today) industry news or interviews?
prompts.why_it_matters: Digital Insight is South Korea's dedicated digital agency publication; trade features, leadership interviews, and case studies enhance B2B trust or reveal public statements made by agency leadership.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the business name with site:ditoday.com on Google; inspect news articles, project reviews, and executive interviews for mentions of the agency.
prompts.found_when: Top search results include published editorial features, project case studies, or founder interviews specifically profiling the agency.
prompts.not_found_when: No editorial articles or news entries on ditoday.com mention the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The agency name consists of ordinary Korean words that match unrelated article body text.

sources_rejected.name: DBCUT Web Design Board & Agency Directory (디비컷 에이전시)
sources_rejected.why: Google search (site:dbcut.com) fails to consistently index individual agency profiles and returns no results for major agencies due to Cloudflare JS challenge shields on dynamic query endpoints.

sources_rejected.name: Korea Internet Professionals Association Corporate Members (한국인터넷전문가협회 단체회원사)
sources_rejected.why: The corporate member directory table is empty on standard HTTP GET requests, as member data is dynamically populated via ASP.NET ViewState and server-side form post events.

sources_rejected.name: Awwwards South Korea Directory (아워즈 대한민국 디렉토리)
sources_rejected.why: English-language international design platform that rarely indexes Korean-script SMB agency names, leading to false-negative not_found results for local domestic businesses.

sources_rejected.name: KIDP Industrial Design Firm Comprehensive Management System (한국디자인진흥원 산업디자인전문회사 종합관리시스템)
sources_rejected.why: Connection times out from external network environments; the design firm registry database requires an authenticated corporate session and cannot be queried via automated GET requests.

sources_rejected.name: DesignDB Directory by KIDP (디자인DB - 한국디자인진흥원)
sources_rejected.why: Connection times out from external network environments; database search requires complex ASP session state and interactive form POST.

sources_rejected.name: KOSA SW Industry Comprehensive Information System (SW산업정보종합시스템 - SWIT)
sources_rejected.why: Server drops foreign/external IP requests; software business confirmation lookup requires business member login and digital certificate authentication.

sources_rejected.name: KONEPS Public Procurement Service (나라장터)
sources_rejected.why: Forces redirection to Single Sign-On (sso.g2b.go.kr) requiring digital certificate / PKI authentication and session cookies; cannot be queried without credentials.

sources_rejected.name: SMINFO Small & Medium Business Information System (중소기업현황정보시스템)
sources_rejected.why: Direct production certification queries require user authentication and digital certificate verification; blocks unauthenticated GET queries with HTTP 405.

sources_rejected.name: Clutch South Korea Web Designers (클러치 대한민국 웹디자인 디렉토리)
sources_rejected.why: Protected by Cloudflare anti-bot challenge and Turnstile verification (returns HTTP 403 Forbidden to automated HTTP clients).

sources_rejected.name: WebWatch Web Accessibility Certification (웹와치 웹 접근성 인증현황)
sources_rejected.why: Root address returns HTTP 404; furthermore, its certification database registers client website URLs rather than the contracting web design agencies.

sources_rejected.name: Freemoa IT Outsourcing Platform (프리모아)
sources_rejected.why: Automated requests are blocked by server security policies with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

sources_rejected.name: Wishket Partner Directory (위시켓 파트너스)
